integrity.binary_carry_step: Derived from Legendre valuation of factorials; no finite experiment is used as proof.
integrity.novelty_scope: Exact valuation and divisibility consequences only; Benoist source formula itself is prior work.
integrity.source_formula_basis: Benoist Example 1.10 and the total-degree identity deg=sum_i deg_i.

scientific_limitations: Characteristic-zero total discriminant degree; no polynomial factorization conclusion is asserted.
Expected dimension is required to be nonnegative, so the pure resultant case c=N+1 is excluded.
Finite checker output is regression evidence, not the infinite proof.
title: A binary-carry formula for the 2-adic degree of equidegree complete-intersection discriminants
